# Index members: index-membership (IDX)

An equity index's members (Dow 30, Nasdaq-100, S&P 500) as their tracking ETF reports holding them; a click opens the member's summary beside. One row per index members, keyed by INDEX. Read by the **us-equities** pack's connector `us-equities-store` (table `<root>/us-equities/index-membership/`). A **snapshot of public data**, captured 2026-10-24 from SEC EDGAR, Nasdaq Trader, GLEIF and Wikidata (tools/publicdata/us_equities.py), refreshed whole by its script (External data); 6 records. A refresh replaces the whole snapshot.

## File layout

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Path | `data/testdata/us-equities/index-membership/` + `snapshot-YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl.gz` |
| Format | JSON Lines: UTF-8, one JSON object a line, gzip-compressed (`.jsonl.gz`) |
| Key field | `INDEX` |
| Date field | none in the record: a snapshot of public data, its file named by the capture date; the demo lake serves the same records on every business date (partition `business_date`) |
| Promoted columns | `INDEX`, `NAME`, `MEMBERS` |
| Vector fields | none |
| Partitioned by | `business_date` |
| A day's file | the whole snapshot |

## Field reference

Every field of the record above, nested ones as dotted paths (`[]` marks an array of objects). *Required* is the contract's; *in N%* is how often the test data fills it.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning | Values, format, unit | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `INDEX` | string | required | The record's id (the business key) | — | `"SP500"` |
| `NAME` | string | required | The index or list's name (Dow Jones Industrial Average, Nasdaq-100, S&P 500, Major US banks …). | — | `"S&P 500"` |
| `MEMBERS` | integer | required | How many members ROWS holds. | — | `495` |
| `ROWS` | array of objects | required | The members, by ticker, one element each with its name, SIC sector and division, exchange, latest revenue and net income in CURRENCY, fiscal year and SINCE. | — | [495 objects] |
| `ROWS[].TICKER` | string | required | The member's ticker (its us-company record's key). | — | `"A"` |
| `ROWS[].NAME` | string | required | The member's name as the pack shows it (Wikidata's label, else EDGAR's name). | — | `"Agilent Technologies"` |
| `ROWS[].SECTOR` | string | required | The name of the member's SIC division. | one of `Agriculture, Forestry and Fishing`, `Construction`, `Finance, Insurance and Real Estate`, `Manufacturing`, `Mining`, `Retail Trade`, `Services`, `Transportation, Communications, Electric, Gas and Sanitary Services`, `Wholesale Trade` | `"Manufacturing"` |
| `ROWS[].SIC` | string | required | The member's SEC SIC code. | — | `"3826"` |
| `ROWS[].SIC_DESCRIPTION` | string | required | The SIC code's description, from EDGAR. | — | `"Laboratory Analytical Instruments"` |
| `ROWS[].EXCHANGE` | string | required | The exchanges the member is listed on. | — | `"NYSE"` |
| `ROWS[].REVENUE` | integer | optional (filled in 96% of `ROWS[]` entries) | The member's revenue for its latest fiscal year. | unit: currency units of ROWS[].CURRENCY | `6948000000` |
| `ROWS[].NET_INCOME` | integer | optional (filled in over 99% of `ROWS[]` entries) | The member's net income for its latest fiscal year; a loss is negative. | unit: currency units of ROWS[].CURRENCY | `1303000000` |
| `ROWS[].CURRENCY` | string | required | The currency the member reports in. | seen: `USD`, `CAD`, `EUR`, `GBP` | `"USD"` |
| `ROWS[].FISCAL_YEAR` | integer | optional (filled in over 99% of `ROWS[]` entries) | The member's latest fiscal year. | seen: `2025`, `2026` | `2025` |
| `ROWS[].SINCE` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | optional (filled in 32% of `ROWS[]` entries) | The date the member joined the index, from Wikidata (YYYY-MM-DD); empty when unknown. | — | `"2000-06-05"` |
| `PROVENANCE` | object | required | Where the membership comes from, one object: SOURCE (the tracking ETF's N-PORT holdings, or a curated list), LICENCE, NOTE and RETRIEVED_AT. | — | {…} |
| `PROVENANCE.SOURCE` | string | required | The public source of the membership (the tracking ETF's Form N-PORT, Wikidata, or Drishti's list of bank filers). | — | `"SEC Form N-PORT of SPY (State Street(R) SPDR(R) S&P 500(R)…` |
| `PROVENANCE.LICENCE` | string | required | The licences of the sources. | seen: `Public domain (SEC EDGAR)`, `Public domain (SEC EDGAR); CC0 1.0 (Wikidata)` | `"Public domain (SEC EDGAR); CC0 1.0 (Wikidata)"` |
| `PROVENANCE.NOTE` | string | required | What the membership is and is not (membership only: index weights and levels are proprietary). | — | `"Membership as the tracking fund holds it on its report dat…` |
| `PROVENANCE.RETRIEVED_AT` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | The date the sources were retrieved (YYYY-MM-DD). | — | `"2026-10-24"` |
| `_meta` | object | optional (filled in every row) | The generator's provenance stamp, one object; optional, carried through in the stored document and not read by Drishti (the contracts leave it out). A bank's extract may omit it. | — | {…} |
| `_meta.source` | string | optional (filled in every `_meta` entry) | The source system or public source the record was built from (sec-edgar, gleif, …). | seen: `drishti list`, `sec-nport` | `"sec-nport"` |
| `_meta.dataset` | string | optional (filled in every `_meta` entry) | The source's data set the record was read from. | — | `"holdings of SPY (Form N-PORT)"` |
| `_meta.licence` | string | optional (filled in every `_meta` entry) | The licence of the source data. | — | `"public domain"` |
| `_meta.retrievedAt` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | optional (filled in every `_meta` entry) | The date the source data was retrieved, YYYY-MM-DD. | — | `"2026-10-24"` |
| `_meta.generation` | integer | optional (filled in every `_meta` entry) | The generator's format generation (always 1). | — | `1` |

## Fields in other rows

None: all 6 rows were read, and every field any of them has is in the record above.

## For the production query

- **Identity:** one record per `INDEX` per `snapshot`; the key is text, unique within the date.
- **Never null:** `INDEX`, `NAME`, `MEMBERS`, `ROWS`, `PROVENANCE` (the contract's required fields).
- **Format:** JSON Lines, UTF-8, one object a line, gzip; field names exactly as shown (UPPER_SNAKE); dates `YYYY-MM-DD`; numbers as JSON numbers, never strings; a missing value is `null` or absent (an empty string is read as empty).
- **Arrays:** keep the order shown (vectors in the scenario set's or the run's order); nested objects as JSON, never flattened.
- Unique: `INDEX` per snapshot.
